**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept classifier and ordinal recurring payment dates**

When a payment schedule uses the common forms `每个月15日`, `每個月十五號`, or `每月第15日`, this exact regex rejects the date while `每月15日` passes. Runtime ingestion consequently adds `source_relation_unresolved` to an otherwise explicit `payment_date`, preventing it from being used; allow the optional `个/個` classifier and `第` within the same validated 1–31 day grammar.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
